summary: Iteration 4 covered the brand-new passless-login flow, 48-photo Drive gallery seed, admin image+video uploads, and full video CRUD. Backend: 22/22 pytest tests pass (added 7 new tests for passless-login, /gallery 48-doc seed, /covers, video upload, videos CRUD end-to-end, passless-cookie gallery CRUD). Frontend: /admin/login auto-signs in and redirects to /admin without any credential entry; the five tabs (Gallery, Videos, Covers·Hero, Projects, Leads) all render without console errors; data-testid=admin-file-upload-input is present under the Gallery Add flow; data-testid=admin-video-upload is present under the Videos Add flow; a full create→delete cycle for a video was performed through the UI successfully. Test video/gallery items created during runs were cleaned up.

issues: Still reads 'Manage the four main gallery tabs...' — stale copy nit carried over from iteration_3.

action_items: OPTIONAL cosmetic: fix stale 'four main gallery tabs' copy in AdminGallery.jsx.

OPTIONAL security: /api/auth/passless-login is currently public — anyone hitting the URL becomes admin. This is per user request but should be gated (env flag / IP allow-list / short expiry) before production.
OPTIONAL: /api/admin/upload has MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES=None — no server-side size ceiling. Kubernetes ingress / uvicorn defaults will still cap, but consider an explicit limit.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py passless-login endpoint (line ~211) has no rate-limiting or gating; anyone who knows the URL gets an admin cookie. This is intentional per user request but is a significant security posture change — flag prominently.
MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES = None disables the app-level size check in /admin/upload; large-file uploads will depend entirely on transport-layer limits.
AdminVideos.jsx line 30 prefixes with process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — matches AdminGallery pattern; correct since backend returns relative /api/uploads/... path.

Startup seed does NOT re-seed the 48 Drive photos; those live in Mongo only (seeded via one-off script). If the DB is ever wiped, /app/backend/scripts/seed_drive_gallery.py must be re-run — worth documenting.
test_credentials: No credentials required — POST /api/auth/passless-login. Fallback admin@caremanto.com / Caremanto@2026 also works.
seed_data_creation: None. Test artefacts (TEST_ prefixed video + gallery items) were cleaned up in-test.
